page0.text:
...
Everyone watches in astonishment.
It's not just me and Tohsaka.
Even Caster, who ought to have been thrilled by a turn in her favor, stares at her own Master in wonder.

page1.text:
Saber's swift attack to Kuzuki's counterattack.
From the nightmare-like neck grab to the impressive throw, it was all incredible, even to the losing side.

page2.text:
...
Saber doesn't move.
She was thrown by her neck and smashed back-first into the wall.
Her neck injury must be fatal.
On top of that, she hit the wall at a speed that was clearly meant to finish her.

page3.text:
I don't think it killed her, but I'm sure she can't move.
At the least, she'll be laying on the ground until the wounds on her neck and bruises all over her body heal.

page4.text:
"No..."
I murmur without realizing.
Even though his fists were Strengthened by Caster's magecraft, Kuzuki's body is still human.
Who would think that he would be able to overwhelm a Servant in melee combat?

page5.text:
"It's fine to assume that a Master's role is to provide support from the rear."
The lean figure turns.
"But there are always exceptions. There are also Masters like me that have no choice but to take the vanguard."

page6.text:
He just proved that to us just now.
Therefore, these two are...
Their fighting roles as Master and Servant are completely swapped...!

page7.text:
"What are you doing, Caster? I told you beforehand.
If you are going to support me, you must take care of the enemy's projectile weapons."

page8.text:
The enemy... Kuzuki stares at Tohsaka.
Saber is less of a threat to him than Tohsaka, who can attack at a distance.
So Kuzuki is wary of targeting us.
He feels that mages ought to battle other mages.

page9.text:
"What happened, Caster? I said that you can do as you wish."
"...No, I will take care of Saber. Souichirou, please take care of the remaining Masters."
"..."

page10.text:
He nods silently and walks towards us.
Behind him, Caster faces the collapsed Saber.

page11.text: "...Bring it on. Saber was taken aback, but now we know how he fights. We just have to beat him before he gets close to us."

page12.text:
Tohsaka slowly retreats, glaring at Kuzuki.
A fight between a mage and a warrior is a fight for distance.
No matter how many monstrous fighting techniques he may have, Kuzuki has no Magic Resistance.

page13.text:
We can win if we can land a hit at range.
Victory is ours if we can manage to cast a spell before he reaches us.

page14.text:
...
Kuzuki faces Tohsaka and doesn't move.
Caster walks towards the wall that Saber was thrown at.

page15.text:
...That action is a mistake.
There's an opening I can take advantage of, so I'll...
